title: Welcome to the BMS Blog
author: Editorial Desk
summary: A space for articles, reflections and field reports from across Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh.
body:
## About this blog

This blog carries **articles, field reports and reflections** from office bearers and karyakartas of Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh.

### How to contribute

- Write your piece using the *Write a Blog* page
- Send the generated file to the web team
- Approved posts appear here, and can be shared to the BMS Facebook page

This is a sample post; replace or delete it.
